lines.en: [totaldays] Days have passed...
: Psst...
: Sensei...
: Wake up...
: Miku?
: Whaddya think yer’ doin’ sleeping in so late when we’ve got stuff to prepare for?
: How did you get into my room?
: Actually, better question. How did you get into my house?
: Oh. Ami let me in.
: She’s doing her hair and stuff and they sent me in here to wake you up since I was the least likely to “do anything weird.”
: So your response is to mount me?
: That’s right! Because what they don’t know is that I’m not actually Miku at all!
: Then who are you exactly?...
: A succubus! Or a demon! Or a bat!
: Or something!
: Actually, I just kinda kept adding random parts of costumes together until I got this.
: I haven’t grown much over the last couple of years, so this year I’m just all three costumes wrapped into one.
: Oh okay. I completely understand why you’re on top of me then.
Miku’s weight presses down against my crotch, which isn’t exactly the smartest move to make on a perverted male first thing in the morning.
Certain biological functions are bound to happen.
And considering the house is full of other girls and no one ever seems to lock doors in Kumon-mi, this could quickly turn into a problem.
: I’m on top of you because I tapped ya on the shoulder a bunch of times and you just wouldn’t wake up.
: But I can see you’re up now, Sensei.
: You mean ‘awake,’ right?
: Hm? What else would I mean?
: You just said “up” with a certain inflection that made me think you might be talking about something else.
: But what else would I be...
: Uhhhhhhh...
: Finally catch on?
: I think so...
: Probably not a smart move to just...hop on ya first thing in the mornin’, huh?
: I mean, I don’t have a problem with it.
: H-How did you even get like...that?!
: Is it the wings?! It's the wings, isn't it?!
: They definitely help, I won’t lie.
: Well, umm...uhh...
: What do we do now?...
Miku freezes on top of me, being extra careful to not move at all.
Probably out of fear of not...stimulating me even more or something.
: What do you mean, “What do we do now?” Isn’t this the part where you take responsibility or something?
: I think that's standard procedure in situations like this.
: N-No way! I’m not even responsible enough to finish my homework! Like heck I’m gonna take responsibility for whatever it is I’m sitting on!
: So you’re just going to...sit there until it goes away?
: How long does that normally take?
: Anywhere from a few minutes to...longer than that?
: I can wait a few minutes.
: It’s not like I’m uncomfortable or anything.
: I didn’t even realize anything weird was underneath me until you pointed it out.
: That’s kind of offensive, Miku.
: Shh! If you keep drawin' attention to it I’ll start thinkin’ weird things and then before I know it we’ll have three kids and a puppy.
: Did you lock the door at least?
: 'Course I didn’t lock the heckin’ door! I didn’t expect ya to get all Dwayne “The Rock” Johnson on me!
: What a strange way to describe an erection.
: Ahhh! This is the exact opposite reason of why the girls chose me to come in here!
: Won’t they get suspicious if you stay in here any longer, then?
: They probably already are suspicious!
: They probably think you’re teaching me how to do the cowboy!
: But if I just...get off of you then it’ll be all like “BAM” and smack me in the face and I’ll get knocked unconscious and stuff!
: How did you go from not feeling anything to worrying about it smacking you in the face?
: How’d you go from thinkin’ I look like a boy to turnin’ into a statue when I get on top of ya?
: I never said you look like a boy. That’s what you always say.
: In fact, I’m pretty sure I’ve told you I think you’re cute on several occasions now.
: You mean those weren’t jokes?
: Why would they be jokes?
: Well...ya know. I’m always surrounded by girls like Karin and Kirin and they make me look even more...Miku-ish than I already am.
: I like Miku-ish girls, I guess.
: Well, um...th-thanks.
: I’ll try to remember that if the others ever trust me enough to wake ya up again...
: Ya know. So I don't...turn you into The Rock and stuff.
: Is it back to normal yet?
: Not even close.
: Really?...
: Being a boy sounds hard. Like really hard.
: Like, super duper extra friggin’ hard.
: Are we still talking about being a boy or have you moved on to talking about my penis?
: I don’t know. I’m feelin’ a lot of stuff I don’t normally feel right now.
: I don’t even know if I could get up right now if I wanted to. My legs feel all stiff and stuff.
: I can relate to that.
: Yeah, I friggin’ know ya can relate to that.
Several minutes have gone by with Miku just...sitting on my lap.
Her body is light and warm, but that’s really all I can say about it right now on account of her vehemently refusing to move.
: So, ya excited for the party tonight?
: Are we just going to have a normal conversation now?
: Well it beats all the innuendos, doesn’t it?
: I know I don’t look like one, but a girl can only handle so much before her brain melts, ya know?
: And it’s not helpin’ that you’re half-naked and stuff.
: Someone could get the wrong idea really quick if they saw us like this.
: Yes, God forbid someone got the wrong idea after seeing this.
Makoto turns on the lights and angrily walks over to the bed.
I think I am in trouble.
: Miku, mind explaining what it is the two of you are doing, exactly?
: ...Just hangin’ out.
: Just hanging out. I see.
: Sensei, do you have anything to add to that?
: Good morning, Makoto. You look nice today.
: Don’t try and fend me off with compliments, bastard!
: Why is Miku riding you like you’re some sort of mechanical bull?!
: Mechanical...bull?...
: She’s just sitting there. She isn’t riding me at all.
: If she’s just sitting there, why doesn’t she get off?
: You’re awake, aren’t you? Isn't that what she came in here to do?
: Oh, r-right! Sensei is awake!
: My job here is done!
: I...still don’t think it’s safe to get up, though!
: And why is that, my self-proclaimed best friend?
: Well, you see Makoto, there’s um...
: There's what?
: SENSEI HAS A BONER AND I’M AFRAID IT WILL SLAP ME IN THE FACE IF I GET OFF OF IT!
: I’M SORRY!
: Wow, you crack easily when Makoto is involved, don’t you?
: It’s been an action-packed morning and I’ve only been up for an hour! Gimme a friggin’ break!
: Miku.
: Step away from the penis.
: Ugh! Fine!
: But this really isn’t my fault!
Does that mean it’s my fault?
But I didn’t even do anything wrong this time.
I get off the bed and stand before Mak-
: Actually, Sensei. Why don’t you take a seat?
: I don’t think you’re, uhh, ready to stand up just yet.
: Oh. Yeah, that makes sense.
I sit back down on the bed after Makoto makes me acutely aware that I have not yet “calmed down.”
: Do you have any idea why I’m here?
: I imagine it’s because Miku was taking too long to wake me up.
: Well I...got the job done, didn’t I?
: I mean why I’m at your house.
: Oh. I imagine it’s something involving the Halloween party based on the way you’re dressed.
: Precisely.
: You are aware that the party tonight is at the Amamiya estate, correct?
: I am aware, yes.
: And have you been informed by any of the connected parties that your assistance is required to set the stage for the occasion?
: Set the stage? You mean I actually have to help prepare?
: Doesn’t Ayane’s family have like...servants or something they could use?
: What about that Geoffrey guy?
: Geoffrey fell mysteriously ill last night.
: He is fine, but since this party is being held without Ayane’s father’s permission, the two of us have been chosen to get everything ready.
: That includes shopping for food and drinks as well as managing the lighting and sound systems.
: Why do I have to be involved in this?
: Oh, that’s easy. Because you can carry more things than everyone else.
: And also, you’re the only person coming to the party without a costume, so you need less time to prepare.
: Of course, there’s the time required for a certain part of you to...return to normal-
: But I trust that you and Miku were about to take care of that any minute, now weren’t you?
: Wha-
: We were not! I told you I was just afraid of bein’ slapped in the face by it!
: You really expect me to believe that?
: Yes!
: Hah...well, whatever the case...just get dressed and get ready so the two of us can go on a little shopping trip.
: Everyone else is going to be heading to Ayane’s early and hanging out in her ballroom until then.
: I believe the mansion has a separate section where we’ll be holding the party, so I’ll have her show us to it once we get there several hours from now.
: Why do you have to be so responsible all the time?
: I need to be or, at this rate, you’ll wind up stealing everyone’s virginity and endangering your career.
: I’m never gonna hear the end of this, am I...
What Makoto doesn’t realize is that stealing everyone's virginity is my exact mission.
But regardless, the two of them leave the room and I get changed, meeting back up with Makoto moments later.
We spend the next few hours scavenging various grocery stores, picking up small things and party favors from all of them.
I figured that her attitude would get better throughout the day, but that is very much not the case.
Her resentment lingers and she has no trouble constantly reminding me of how innocent Miku is and how I’m just trying to corrupt her.
And while that isn’t entirely incorrect, it’s not entirely correct either.
But of course, I know how it looked, so there’s no sense in arguing about it.
Eventually, the two of us make it to Ayane’s place and are immediately escorted through a large courtyard to a traditional Japanese-style dojo where the party will be taking place.
We spend the next few hours setting everything up without a single break before the “festivities” finally begin...
Miku’s affection has increased to [miku_love]!
Roughly thirty minutes later...
